mapper.select: SELECT id FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT currency, total_topups, total_spent, total_topups - total_spent AS remaining_amount FROM ( SELECT c.currency, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(t.amount) FROM cash_topups t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.currency = c.currency), 0) AS total_topups, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.amount) FROM expenses e WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.currency = c.currency AND e.use_topup_balance), 0) AS total_spent FROM (VALUES ('USD'), ('KHR')) AS c(currency) ) totals
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cash_topups WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id, amount, currency, topup_date, note, created_at FROM cash_topups WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cash_topups(id, user_id, amount, currency, topup_date, note) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{topupDate}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE cash_topups SET amount = #{amount}, currency = #{currency}, topup_date = #{topupDate}, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cash_topups WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id}
